marker_reviews.reason: Both EXECUTE statements replace the definitions of the already-applied api.source_capture_inventory_exact(text) function and api.source_capture_inventory view with text derived from their live catalog definitions. Their durable outcome is therefore the changed pg_proc and pg_views definition rather than a newly created catalog object. Catalog contract dcp_inventory_family_classification_v1 reads the exact function definition back after apply, requires both DCP family patterns and both non-other source-system labels, and verifies the browser-safe view exposes exactly 20 Lucasfilm and 20 Twentieth Century DCP tables with neither family falling through to other. The contract is a strict superset of all_licensor_property_source_coverage_v1, preserving all prior source-inventory assertions. No table row, grant, policy, or api.db_data_admin_scraped_properties definition is changed.
